scope_boundaries.orbit_reconstruction: Real-coefficient polynomials; finite mixed observations of correlated replicas with variable positive-definite covariance. It does not identify the orbit from the ordinary marginal moment sequence.
scope_boundaries.local_origin_formula: For degree bound m>=3, local origin Hessian is invertible regardless of other critical points; its normalized formal series equals the Gaussian moment series.
scope_boundaries.global_de_Rham_rank: Leading homogeneous gradient isolated; rank (m-1)^d on each active coupling support. This excludes the nodal square-of-conic leading phase.
scope_boundaries.intrinsic_rank_one_projection: Additional Morse and central-nonresonance assumptions are retained in Section7.3, not implied by the local origin formula.
scope_boundaries.not_imported: No global cubic GMC theorem, external review of our notes, all-parameter cyclicity or derivation of correlated data from pure vanishing.

local_exact_obstruction.pure_series: 1 at every positive order by formal Gaussian translation

assurance: Primary-source scope audit and exact internal obstruction. No claim that the source paper is false; no independent specialist review or formal verification.
